dem.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic

imagery.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation Context Camera Orthorectified Image Mosaic

geology_reference.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars
geology_reference.registration_warning: USGS readme: random offsets of about 100-200 metres from surface-operations CTX mosaic.
geology_reference.status: Downloaded; 8 source features clipped and exported; 4 science regions retain source geometry, names and FIDs.

optical_leaflet_note: Use data/processed/imagery_config.json and the Mars-geographic PNG overlay in Leaflet's EPSG4326-style angular display with a custom Mars radius for distance; not Earth EPSG3857.

hirise.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM Mosaic
hirise.acquisition: Native 1002x1002 source-pixel window with halo, not the full original mosaic
hirise.status: Acquired and processed as a separate high-resolution terrain grid; not merged into CTX.

global_context.title: Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic (MDIM 2.1)
global_context.purpose: Whole-planet visual browsing only, not global routing or DEM.
global_context.color_note: Official artistically colorized mosaic, not true-color photography.

global_topography.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR global topography and observation counts
global_topography.provider: NASA GSFC / NASA PDS Geosciences Node
global_topography.purpose: Approximate global planning and relief display; detailed local routing remains separate.
global_topography.note: Includes official interpolated bins, identifiable by zero observation counts. Not local traversability.

regional_terrain.source: Same original USGS Science Investigation CTX DEM; native values retained
regional_terrain.note: Covers the complete regional optical footprint. NoData and slope/grade limits remain enforced; no global Mars routing.
